ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Project
ns2:course.description: Students work with an instructor on a special project or applied research related to real world urban problems and professional practice. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 3 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of Capstone advisor. Restricted to upper division students in Urban Planning.
